# 2b Links and the public fetch: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 2](./README.md#phase-2-subscriptions), [link lifecycle](../processes/subscriptions/link-lifecycle.md), [subscription fetch](../processes/subscriptions/subscription-fetch.md), [subscription format](../integrations/subscription-format.md), [subscriptions module → Links](../modules/subscriptions.md#links), [architecture → HTTP surfaces](../architecture.md#http-surfaces), [ADR 0004](../adr/0004-one-shared-credential-per-endpoint.md), [ADR 0006](../adr/0006-one-public-host-for-admin-and-public-urls.md), designs `RP-Links`, `RP-Link-new`, `RP-Link`, `RP-Phone-link`, and the **As built** of 2a (and of 1h for the public-route patterns of `/agent/`).

**Done when:** links can be created (token, URL, QR), listed and filtered, disabled and enabled, given a new token, moved to another subscription, given, extended or cleared an expiry, edited, and deleted with a 30-day tombstone; `GET` and `HEAD /s/{token}` answer exactly as the fetch doc says, rate limited per client IP, and every `GET` is recorded with its network and app; `subscription.all_unhealthy` is raised at most once an hour per subscription; a subscription with links offers **Move links to…** before **Delete**; tokens never reach a log; every checklist line has its test.

Not in 2b: the expiry scan and its notifications, tombstone token erasure, shared-link alerts, countries (2c); cut-off (2d). A link already serves its expired stub and its tombstone's `404` from the clock alone, so 2b is complete for apps.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Service | `links.Service` (Deps: DB, Vault, Events, Settings, I18n, `Subs *subs.Service`, `Now`, `BaseURL`, Log). `Module.Links`. | Build README layout. |
| Token | `vault.NewToken()` (43 characters, base64url). Insert the link with `token = X''` and `token_lookup = Vault.Lookup(token)`, then set `token = Vault.SealString(token, "link:<id>:token")` in the same transaction (`OpenString` reads it back). The URL is `<PROXIER_BASE_URL without a trailing slash>/s/<token>`. | 2a Tables; Build README "Secrets". |
| Where the token appears | Only the link page: the URL field shows `…/s/` + 22 bullets until **Reveal** (htmx fragment, `no-store`); **Copy URL** (primary, key `y`) holds the URL in `data-copy`; **Show QR** fetches the QR fragment (`no-store`). The link page is `no-store` like every admin page. Lists, search, the dashboard, Activity, notifications, job payloads and logs never hold it. | Build README default "Copy URL is one tap". |
| Create | Page `GET /links/new` styled as the design's dialog: **name** (trimmed, 1–80, unique among live links: `links.err.name_taken`), **subscription** (select; preselected from `?subscription=` or when only one exists; none exist → the page says to create one first, with a link), **expiry** (Never / On: a date and an optional time), **language** (default `subscriptions.link_language`), **note** (≤ 1 000). `POST /links`: errors inline (422, nothing created); success → one `Write` (insert, seal, `link.created{subscription, expiry}`) → `/links/:id?created=1`, whose band says "Link created. Share the URL or let them scan the code." | link-lifecycle.md "creating and sharing". |
| Expiry | Form: `expiry=never\|on`, `expiry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `expiry_time` (HH:MM, optional), read in the display zone (`general.time_zone`). Date only → 00:00 of the next day; with a time → that minute. Must be after now (`links.err.expiry_past`). Stored as 2a defines (the first expired moment). Shown as "until 1 Dec 2026" when it falls on midnight in the display zone (a date-only expiry), else "until 1 Dec 2026, 18:00"; the form's hint says "Works until 1 Dec, 23:59 Moscow time. Then the app shows “⏳ Expired on 1 Dec 2026 · contact @tikhonp”." | link-lifecycle.md; 2a "Expiry instant". |
| Status | `active`, `disabled`, `deleted` are stored; the shown status adds **expired** = active with `expires ≤ now`. Markers: active `ok`, disabled and expired `off`, deleted `gone`. | ui/README status vocabulary. |
| Disable / Enable | **Disable…** is strength 2 with link-lifecycle.md's text ("Their app's list becomes the “disabled” entry on its next refresh. Copied URIs keep working until you rotate the servers."). It sets `disabled_at`; **Enable** (no dialog) clears it. `link.disabled` / `link.enabled`; an action that changes nothing records nothing. A disabled link keeps its expiry. | |
| Regenerate token | Strength 2 ("The old URL stops working at once. Apps holding it keep their last list. Send the new URL to Alex."). New token and lookup in one `UPDATE`; `link.token_regenerated`. → `/links/:id?regenerated=1` with a band "New URL ready: copy it and send it." | |
| Change subscription | Page with the other subscriptions in a select. `link.subscription_changed{from, to}` (names). The format override is kept; a format the new subscription doesn't allow falls back to its default at fetch time (2a `PickFormat`). | |
| Expiry actions | Page: Never / On (as Create). Set, extend or clear in one place. `link.expiry_changed{from, to}` (db.Time text or `""`). Any change clears `expiry_warned_at` and `expired_at`, so 2c warns and notifies again for the new expiry. | link-lifecycle.md "extending an expired link serves the real output again". |
| Edit | Page: name, note, language, format override ("the subscription's default" or one of its allowed formats). `link.changed{fields}` with the changed fields' names; nothing changed → nothing recorded. | Every state change records an event (CLAUDE.md). |
| Delete | Strength 2 explaining the tombstone ("The link leaves the lists. Its URL serves “⛔ Link removed” for 30 days (the tombstone period), so their app drops the servers, then 404. Copied URIs keep working until you rotate the servers."). `state = deleted`, `deleted_at`; `link.deleted`. The tombstone lasts `subscriptions.tombstone` (default 30 days; the period in force applies to every deleted link), **checked at fetch time**; 2c erases the token afterwards. Until it ends the link holds its subscription (2a). A deleted link's page is read-only: "Deleted on 8 Oct 2026. Its URL serves “⛔ Link removed” until 7 Nov 2026." Every action on it answers 409 (`links.ErrDeleted`). | link-lifecycle.md; ADR 0004. |
| Move links | `POST /subscriptions/:id/move-links` (`to=<id>`, another subscription) from the delete page: every live link of the subscription moves, one `link.subscription_changed` each, in one `Write`; tombstones stay. **Delete** is offered once nothing holds the subscription (2a). | subscription-management.md step 5. |
| What a link serves | `links.Service.Serve(ctx, l Link, query string, masked bool) (output.Response, string /*format*/, error)`: the subscription (a tombstone always has one: 2a), `PickFormat(query, allowed, default, l.Format)`, the members in service (`subs.Service.Members`), `output.Build` with a localizer for the link's language and the display zone, contact from `general.admin_contact`, `now` from the module's clock. The fetch, the link page's preview and 2c use it. | One place. |
| Fetch route | `GET` and `HEAD /s/:token` on `r.Public` (registered by `fetch.Service.Register(g *echo.Group)`). In order: (1) the platform's limiter (middleware); (2) the token must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,64}$`, be found by lookup, and not be a tombstone past `subscriptions.tombstone` (a deleted link without a subscription counts as ended); otherwise `echo.ErrNotFound`, the same plain `404` any unknown public path gets, and nothing is recorded; (3) `Serve` with `?format=`; `ErrBadFormat` → `400`, not recorded; (4) `GET` only: record (below); (5) `200` with `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`, the output's headers in order, the body (`HEAD`: the same status and headers, no body). A trailing slash is removed by the platform before routing; tokens are case-sensitive; cookies are already stripped by the public chain. | subscription-fetch.md steps and rules. |
| Recording | One `Write` before the response is written: insert the fetch (`ip`, `network`, `user_agent` cut to 256 characters, `app`, `format`, `outcome`), set the link's `last_fetch_at/app/network`, and when the response has `AllHidden` and the subscription's `all_unhealthy_at` is NULL or at least an hour old: set it to now and record `subscription.all_unhealthy{servers, count}` (actor `system`). If the write fails, log `subscriptions: record fetch` with the error (never the token) and still answer: apps must not lose their list over a log. | subscription-fetch.md step 7; "at most once an hour". |
| Client IP and network | `c.RealIP()` (the platform's extractor: `X-Real-IP` only from a trusted proxy). `fetch.Network(addr)`: unmap IPv4-in-IPv6; IPv4 → its /24, IPv6 → its /48, as `netip.Prefix.Masked().String()`. | shared-link-alerts.md step 1. |
| App detection | `fetch.Detect(ua)`: subscription-format.md's table, in its order, case-insensitive substring, first match wins; returns the family name as the table writes it ("Happ", "v2RayTun", "Clash / mihomo", "curl / scripts", …), or `""` for "Other". Pages show "Other: <user agent>" for `""`. The table is a Go slice in `fetch/detect.go`. | |
| Rate limit (platform) | `web.Limiter{Max int, Window time.Duration, Now func() time.Time}`, a fixed window per client IP, created in `platform.Open` as `App.PublicLimit` (`Max 60`, `Window 1m`) and passed to `web.Mount` through `web.Deps.PublicLimit`. Its middleware joins the public chain and applies to `/s/`, `/r/`, `/f/` (also to unknown paths there), not to `/agent/` (limited per session since 1h). Over the limit: `429` with `Retry-After` = whole seconds to the window's end (at least 1), plain "Too Many Requests". `Max = 0` turns it off (tests that make many requests). When it tracks more than 10 000 IPs it drops windows that ended. | subscription-fetch.md step 1; architecture.md "rate-limited per client IP". |
| Logs (platform) | `httpx.MaskPath(p)`: for paths under `/s/`, `/r/`, `/f/` the segment after the prefix becomes `•••` (`/s/•••`, `/r/•••/home.conf`). The request logger logs `MaskPath(path)`; `web.ErrorHandler` logs it on 5xx. | link-lifecycle.md: a token is never in a log. |
| Links list | `GET /links` (`RP-Links`): title block with "14 active · 2 expiring this week" and **New link** (primary, key `n`). Filter bar (in the URL): name (contains, any case), subscription, state (`live` default = not deleted, `active`, `disabled`, `expired`, `deleted`, `all`), chip "Expiring ≤ 7 d" (active, expiring within 7 days, not yet expired). Columns: link (name), subscription, status (marker + word), expires ("never" / "8 Oct · in 3 days" / "expired 30 Sep"), last fetch ("2 min ago · Streisand" / "never fetched"), fetches in 24 h. Sorted by last fetch, newest first, never-fetched last, then by name. Rows `data-row`, `data-href`. Footer when tombstones exist and the filter isn't `deleted`: "3 deleted links still serve “Link removed”" linking to `?state=deleted`. Filtering and sorting in Go (the list is small). | modules/subscriptions.md#pages. |
| Link page | `GET /links/:id` (`RP-Link`, `RP-Phone-link`). Title block: name, the status marker, the line "Friends · until 1 Dec 2026 · English · created 12 Mar", **Copy URL** (primary, `y`), **Disable…** or **Enable**. Then, in this DOM order (desktop: two columns; phone: one, so the sharing parts come first): bands (created / regenerated / disabled / expired / deleted); **URL** (the masked field, Reveal, Copy, "The token is shown only here, never in notifications, events or logs."); **QR code** ("In the app: add subscription → scan QR.", **Show QR** / **Hide QR**); **What the app gets now** (`Serve(masked)`: status and format, the headers, the lines; for a stub, the stub; "Built on every fetch. Nothing is cached."); **Link** (subscription with its servers' names and **Change…**, expiry and **Set…**, language, format, last fetch "12 min ago · v2RayTun · 2001:db8:4f2::/48", note, created); **Fetch log** ("kept 90 days", from `subscriptions.fetch_retention`: time, IP, app, format, outcome; the newest 50 and **Older →** with `?before=<fetch id>`; none: "None yet. The first fetch from their app shows up here."); **Actions** (each with its one-line consequence: Regenerate token…, Change subscription…, Set expiry…, Edit…, Delete…); **Activity** (the last 10 events of `link:<id>`). | ui/README link page; the phone flow "copy a link URL or show its QR". |
| Subscription page | The **Links** area lists its live links (name, status, last fetch) and **New link** joins the title block (`/links/new?subscription=<id>`). The delete page gains **Move links to…**. | 2a left the area empty. |
| Nav, search, names | Nav: **Links** `/links`, `g l`, order 20. Search: live links by name; label = name, meta "link · Family · disabled", href = the link page. `SubjectNamer`: `link` → name (also for deleted links), `/links/<id>`. | |

## Go signatures

### `subscriptions/links`

```go
// The tombstone period is the setting subscriptions.tombstone (conf.Tombstone).

var (
	ErrNotFound = errors.New("links: no such link")
	ErrDeleted  = errors.New("links: the link is deleted")
)

type Link struct {
	ID             int64
	SubscriptionID int64 // 0 only for a deleted link whose tombstone ended before its subscription was deleted
	Name, Note     string
	State          string    // active, disabled, deleted
	Expires        time.Time // zero: never
	Lang           i18n.Lang
	Format         string    // "" = the subscription's default
	AlertNetworks, AlertApps int // 0 = the setting (2c)
	AlertsMuted    bool
	AlertedAt      time.Time
	CreatedAt, DisabledAt, DeletedAt, LastFetchAt time.Time
	LastFetchApp, LastFetchNetwork string
}
func (l Link) Expired(now time.Time) bool  // !Expires.IsZero() && !now.Before(Expires)
func (l Link) Status(now time.Time) string // active, disabled, expired, deleted
func (l Link) TombstoneEnds(period time.Duration) time.Time // DeletedAt + period

type New struct {
	Name, Note     string
	SubscriptionID int64
	Expires        time.Time // zero: never
	Lang           i18n.Lang
}
type Edit struct {
	Name, Note string
	Lang       i18n.Lang
	Format     string
}
type Filter struct {
	Name           string
	SubscriptionID int64
	State          string // live (default), active, disabled, expired, deleted, all
	ExpiringWithin time.Duration // 0: off
}
type Row struct {
	Link
	Subscription string // name
	Fetches24h   int
}

func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, n New, actor string) (int64, error) // store.FieldErrors
func (s *Service) Get(ctx context.Context, id int64) (Link, error)
func (s *Service) ByToken(ctx context.Context, token string) (Link, bool, error) // lookup; false when unknown
func (s *Service) Token(ctx context.Context, id int64) (string, error)
func (s *Service) URL(token string) string
func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, f Filter) ([]Row, error)
func (s *Service) Disable(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) Enable(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) RegenerateToken(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) ChangeSubscription(ctx context.Context, id, subscriptionID int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) SetExpiry(ctx context.Context, id int64, expires time.Time, actor string) error // zero clears
func (s *Service) Edit(ctx context.Context, id int64, e Edit, actor string) error // store.FieldErrors
func (s *Service) Delete(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) MoveAll(ctx context.Context, fromSub, toSub int64, actor string) (moved int, err error)
func (s *Service) Serve(ctx context.Context, l Link, query string, masked bool) (output.Response, string, error)

// ParseExpiry reads the form's fields in the display zone. "never" → zero.
func ParseExpiry(mode, date, clock string, zone *time.Location, now time.Time) (time.Time, error)
```

}

### `substest` additions

`New` also points `App.PublicLimit.Now` at the harness clock, so `Advance` moves the limiter's windows too; a test that makes more than 60 fetches from one address sets `h.App.PublicLimit.Max = 0`.

```go
// Link creates a link through the service and returns its id and token.
func (h *Harness) Link(subID int64, name string) (int64, string)
// Fetch requests path from addr ("198.51.100.23:5000" when empty) with a user agent.
func (h *Harness) Fetch(method, path, addr, ua string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /s/:token`, `HEAD /s/:token` | Public: the link's output |
| `GET /links` | List and filters |
| `GET /links/new`, `POST /links` | Create → `/links/:id?created=1` |
| `GET /links/:id` | Link page (`?before=<fetch id>` pages the fetch log) |
| `GET /links/:id/url` | Revealed URL fragment (`no-store`; `?hide=1` → the masked one) |
| `GET /links/:id/qr` | QR fragment (`no-store`; `?hide=1` → the button again) |
| `POST /links/:id/disable`, `POST /links/:id/enable` | Strength 2 / none |
| `POST /links/:id/regenerate` | Strength 2 → `?regenerated=1` |
| `GET`, `POST /links/:id/subscription` | Change subscription |
| `GET`, `POST /links/:id/expiry` | Set, extend, clear |
| `GET`, `POST /links/:id/edit` | Name, note, language, format |
| `POST /links/:id/delete` | Strength 2 → `/links` |
| `POST /subscriptions/:id/move-links` | `to=<id>` → the delete page |

## Events

Recorded: `link.created`, `link.disabled`, `link.enabled`, `link.token_regenerated`, `link.subscription_changed`, `link.expiry_changed`, `link.changed`, `link.deleted`, `subscription.all_unhealthy`. None carries the token.

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/processes/subscriptions/subscription-fetch.md`: an unknown token gets the platform's plain public `404` (the same as any unknown path; not an empty body); a malformed token is unknown; the limit counts `/s/`, `/r/`, `/f/` and not `/agent/`; `Retry-After`; a failed recording is logged and the answer still goes out; `expire` is the last second the link works; the header names are sent in lower case.
- `docs/processes/subscriptions/link-lifecycle.md`: the expiry is stored as the first expired moment; changing it re-arms the warning and the expired notification; the edits record `link.changed{fields}`; a deleted link's page is read-only; regenerate shows a band with the new URL ready to copy; the token lives in the link page's Copy button (masked on screen).
- `docs/integrations/subscription-format.md`: the fragment and `filename*` escaping (everything but `A–Z a–z 0–9 - . _ ~`); the date format ("1 Dec 2026" / "1 дек 2026").
- `docs/modules/subscriptions.md`: the stub table's date format; Copy URL; a deleted link holds its subscription until its tombstone ends; the tombstone period is a setting (default 30 days).
- `docs/architecture.md#http-surfaces`: 60 requests per minute per IP on `/s/`, `/r/`, `/f/`; Proxier's log masks their tokens.
- `docs/events.md`: `subscription.all_unhealthy{servers, count}` raised by fetches (actor `system`).

## Checklist

The fetch, in `fetch/fetch_test.go` (substest harness):

- [ ] Family = nl-1, de-1 → `200`, two `vless://` lines in order named "🇳🇱 Netherlands 1" and "🇩🇪 Germany 1", `Content-Type`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Robots-Tag` and the four profile headers — `TestFetchServesURIsAndHeaders`
- [ ] `?format=uri-base64` (allowed) → the base64 of the two lines — `TestFetchBase64Format`
- [ ] `?format=mihomo` → `400`; a format the subscription doesn't allow → `400`; neither is recorded — `TestFetchBadFormat`
- [ ] A token that doesn't exist, a malformed one and `/s/` alone → the same `404` as `/s/nope/extra`; nothing recorded — `TestUnknownTokenIs404`
- [ ] Disabled → `200`, one stub "⛔ Link disabled · contact @tikhonp" (without a contact: "⛔ Link disabled"); enabled → the real output — `TestDisableAndEnable`
- [ ] An expired link with language RU → `200`, one stub "⏳ Срок истёк 1 дек 2026 · пишите @tikhonp" — `TestExpiredStubInRussian`
- [ ] Expiry 2026-12-01 (date only) in Europe/Moscow → the real output at 23:59:59 Moscow time, the stub at 00:00:00 on 2 Dec; `expire=1796158799` — `TestDateOnlyExpiryEndsAtMidnight`
- [ ] Extending an expired link's expiry → the next fetch serves the real output — `TestExtendExpiredLink`
- [ ] A disabled link that also expired → "disabled" — `TestDisabledWinsOverExpired`
- [ ] Deleted: 10 days later → "⛔ Link removed"; 31 days later → `404`; gone from the default list — `TestDeletedLinkTombstone`
- [ ] A subscription with no servers → "⚠️ No servers yet" — `TestFetchEmptySubscriptionStub`
- [ ] Hide unhealthy on, de-1 blocked past the grace → only nl-1 — `TestFetchHidesUnhealthy`
- [ ] Both past the grace → both served and one `subscription.all_unhealthy`; a fetch 30 min later → no second; 61 min later → a second — `TestAllUnhealthyOncePerHour`
- [ ] nl-1's credential changed a second ago (catalog) → the next fetch carries the new one — `TestFetchAfterRotation`
- [ ] de-1 moved above nl-1 → the next fetch serves de-1 first — `TestFetchFollowsServerOrder`
- [ ] The 61st request in a minute from one IP → `429` with `Retry-After`; another IP still gets `200`; the next window serves again — `TestFetchRateLimited`
- [ ] From the trusted tunnel with `X-Real-IP: 203.0.113.9` → recorded 203.0.113.9 and `203.0.113.0/24`; a direct request with that header → the socket address — `TestFetchRecordsClientIP`
- [ ] `HEAD` → the same status and headers, no body, nothing recorded — `TestHeadRecordsNothing`
- [ ] The title "Семья" → `profile-title: base64:0KHQtdC80YzRjw==` — `TestTitleHeaderIsBase64`
- [ ] A 2 KB user agent → stored cut to 256 characters — `TestLongUserAgentIsTrimmed`
- [ ] `/s/<token>/` answers like `/s/<token>`; the token in other letter case → `404` — `TestTokenPathRules`
- [ ] The answer sets no cookie, and a cookie sent with the request changes nothing — `TestFetchTouchesNoCookies`
- [ ] A recorded fetch sets the link's last fetch (time, app, network) — `TestFetchUpdatesLastFetch`

Detection, in `fetch/detect_test.go`:

- [ ] Each family of the table from a real-looking user agent; "v2rayNG/1.8.5" → v2rayNG (not v2rayN); "Mozilla/5.0 … Clash" → Clash / mihomo; "okhttp/4.12" → "" — `TestDetectApp`
- [ ] IPv4 → /24, IPv6 → /48, `::ffff:198.51.100.7` → `198.51.100.0/24` — `TestNetwork`

Links, in `links/links_test.go`:

- [ ] Create → active, a 43-character token, the URL `http://proxier.test/s/<token>`, `link.created{subscription, expiry}`; the token is in no event and no job — `TestCreateLink`
- [ ] A live link's name again → refused; a deleted link's name → allowed — `TestLinkNamesAreUnique`
- [ ] Regenerate → the old URL `404`s at once and the new one serves; `link.token_regenerated` — `TestRegenerateToken`
- [ ] Change the subscription from Family to Friends → the next fetch serves Friends' servers; `link.subscription_changed{from: Family, to: Friends}` — `TestChangeSubscription`
- [ ] Expiry: in the past refused; a date and time read in Europe/Moscow; clearing records `link.expiry_changed{to: ""}`; any change clears the warning marks — `TestExpiryRules`
- [ ] Edit records `link.changed{fields}` with exactly the changed fields; no change, no event — `TestEditLink`
- [ ] Every action on a deleted link → `ErrDeleted`; disabling a disabled link records nothing — `TestDeletedLinkIsReadOnly`
- [ ] "Friends" with 3 links → its delete page offers **Move links to…**; after moving them → deleted; one `link.subscription_changed` per link — `TestDeleteWithLinksNeedsMove`
- [ ] `subscriptions.tombstone` set to 7 days → a link deleted 8 days ago `404`s and its page names the end it passed; at the default 30 days the same link still serves "⛔ Link removed"; a deleted link without a subscription `404`s — `TestTombstoneSettingApplies`

Platform:

- [ ] Limiter: 61st in a window → `429` + `Retry-After`; other IPs unaffected; a new window resets; unknown `/s/…` paths count; `/agent/…` is never limited; `Max 0` is off — `internal/platform/web/limit_test.go` `TestPublicRateLimit`
- [ ] The request log and a 5xx error log write `/s/•••` and `/r/•••/x.conf`, never the token (`httpx.New` + `web.Mount` with a log buffer and a `/s/:token` route answering 500) — `internal/platform/web/web_http_test.go` `TestTokenPathsAreMaskedInLogs`
